name: NCC Ltd
title: NCC Ltd - 500294 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Record INR83,004 cr order book (~4x book-to-bill) but management withheld all FY27 guidance citing uncertainty; standalone FY26 revenue fell 9% and consolidated EBITDA margin in Q4 was 8.83% vs 9.07%.

capex.quote: the capex plan is INR500 crores

triggers.label: FY27 guidance withheld
triggers.quote: So we have decided not to give any guidance for FY27.

triggers.label: Receivable days 87 → 73
triggers.quote: the number of days also has decreased from 87 days to 73 days in the current quarter

triggers.label: Capex FY27 INR500 cr vs FY26 ~INR912 cr
triggers.quote: FY27, the capex plan is INR500 crores.

triggers.label: Standalone revenue FY26 down 9%
triggers.quote: For the full year, the turnover stands at INR 17,669 crores as against INR 19,393 crores

triggers.label: Cost pressure, escalation cover partial
triggers.quote: About 74% of the contracts, we have escalation clauses. But I'm not very sure

guidance.metric: FY27 revenue, margin, order inflow guidance
guidance.quote: So we have decided not to give any guidance for FY27.

red_flags.label: No FY27 guidance despite record order book
red_flags.quote: So we have decided not to give any guidance for FY27.

red_flags.label: Escalation cover uncertain
red_flags.quote: But I'm not very sure whether the increase in the prices will completely get covered under the escalation clauses.

red_flags.label: JJM UP receivables and interest load
red_flags.quote: As far as the receivables are concerned, the receivables have come down to INR3,015 crores

evasions.quote: It is not really helpful to talk about any hypothetical number and tomorrow revise that number.
we'll be able to tell you at the end of the quarter, we have to wait, watch and see patiently.
